lines.text: Babe... do you know what day it is today?
lines.say: [suspicious] Babe... do you know what day it is today?

lines.text: Of course I know! Wait right here!
lines.say: [nervous laugh] Of course I know! [hurried] Wait right here!

lines.text: It's trash day. You forgot the trash. Again.
lines.say: [deadpan] It's trash day. You forgot the trash. [sighs] Again.
